english: Looks like we got caught up in\nDoctor Death's jump to another world.
Where is he? Is he hiding?
I don't sense anything like that, but who knows?
(He should've had plenty of chances to attack us.\nBut he never made a move...?)
Where is this place?\nDoctor Death said something about "that hideout" -\ncould this be it?
Doesn't feel like it, though.
Looks like there's nothin' here at all, though?
//SE: higurashi cicadas crying
Is that the cry of the higurashi...?\nEarly summer in Japan - June, I wonder.
For now, let's head out to the main road.
//BG: Hinamizawa (day)
Whoa, talk about the boonies!
Mmm, delicious.\nYou can really tell the air itself has flavor.
Doctor Death's hideout is in a place like this?\nKinda hard to believe.
A mysterious figure in a secluded Western-style mansion -\nthat's a classic setup.
Doesn't even look like there's a mansion here!\nLike, "Doctor Death is hiding in that watermill" -\nthat's a joke, right?!
But Doctor Death definitely came here.\nHe's gotta be somewhere.
True. First we need to gather\ninformation about this land.
There's a place name on the sign.\nLet's see... Hi-na-mi-za-wa?
Hello.
//Event CG: first meeting with Rena. A calm, gentle smile
Everyone's wearing weird clothes...\nYou're not from Hinamizawa, right?\nTraveling, kana? Kana?
Yes, we just arrived.\nAre you from this village?
Yes. I'm Rena - Ryugu Rena.
Hey, got a sec?
Yes?
Has anything weird happened in this village lately?\nLike seeing a strange person.
//Event CG off
Hey, say something.
There's nothing here.\nMore importantly...
Huh?
Hauu!! So cuuute!!\nI wanna take you home!!
Hey!? What!? What is this!?\nWait, *I* couldn't dodge?!
Hauu!! Hau! Hau!\nSo cuuute!
I-I can't get away!!\nHey! Let go of me! Sheesh!!
Struggling's no use.\nNobody can beat Rena\nonce she's in cute mode.
Ah, Mii-chan!
Yo, Rena.\nJeez, can't you pick your targets?
Ehehe...
Haa, haa... You'd never guess from the looks,\nbut what ridiculous strength, and that speed...
Country-raised kids catch bugs and fish,\nso nature trains them up.\nDon't underestimate them, okay?
Who're these people? Friends of yours, Rena?
They said they're here traveling.\nPretty unusual, right?
Haha, yeah.\nI mean, there's nothing here at all.
You seem easier to talk to than her.\nI want to ask about this land?
Then, in Rena's place,\nI'll talk - Sonozaki Mion.\nYou wanna hear about tourist spots and stuff?
Um, well, kinda...
Huh? You came to see\ntomorrow's Watanagashi, right?
Watanagashi?
No?\nComing to Hinamizawa for sightseeing at this time of year,\nI'd figure you're after the Watanagashi festival.
Hmm, a festival. Nice!
Are you staying over today, kana? Kana?
Well, if tomorrow's the festival,\nmaybe we should check it out?
Then I'll show you around.\nThis must be fate, right?
The way she's looking at me is creepy, though...
Hauu!
Hey, Rena!\nIf you keep that up, mister here\nwill play a prank on you, you know?
Okaaay... hauu.
...Now then, putting that aside,\nI'll show you around the Watanagashi festival.\nIt's your first time, right?
Thanks, that helps.
Well, we're off!
See you again tomorroww.
//Rena and Mion leave
There they go.
What festival?! We're not here\nto play around, you know!
Of course we're not here to enjoy the festival.\nThat's just our cover story.
Huh!? Is that so?
Our goal is finding Doctor Death and\npreventing the incident.
We'll split up and search the area,\ngather information on Hinamizawa village,\nand prepare for tomorrow's festival.
...Hm?\nCome to think of it, tomorrow,\nwhere were we meeting Rena and the others?
Ah, we never decided that.
I'll chase after Rena and ask her.
S-shouldn't I go instead?
Wow, Aria going herself?\nThat's unusual.
Shut up! ...There's something bugging me.\nI can't leave it to an apprentice slave.
//BG: garbage dump (evening)
There were few footprints, so following was easy, but\na garbage dump... what business\nwould anyone have here...?
//Sound of stepping on paper with a rustle
...Hm? An old magazine?
'Nightmare tragedy at the Hinamizawa dam.\nWorkers dismembered in murder.'\n...Huh?
Wh-what is this...?
'The culprits beat the victim to death\nwith hatchets and pickaxes,\nthen dismembered the body...'
'One of the culprits is still at large'...
You're telling me a tragedy like that\nhappened in this village?
//A clattering sound
//Event CG: Rena standing at the garbage dump, carrying a hatchet, nearly expressionless
U-um... so.
//Event CG off
...Is that you, Aria-chan, kana? Kana?
What are you doing here\ncarrying something like that?
Ah, this?\nAhaha, did I startle you?
A Kenta-kun doll is buried alive\nin this garbage dump.\nI'm gonna dig it out with this hatchet.
Kenta-kun doll?
He's cute. Look, over there!
This white-bearded old man doll is cute?\nAnd I'm treated the same as that...
Why did you come here,\nAria-chan?
Because you never said where we'd meet tomorrow,\nI chased after you to ask about that.
Ah, right. My bad.\nLet's meet at 4 at\nthe watermill from earlier, kana? Kana?
4 o'clock at the watermill. Got it.\nWell, I'm heading back to the others.
Wait.
Earlier you asked,\nif anything strange happened in Hinamizawa lately,\nand if we'd seen any weird people, right?
Yes, so?
Why would a traveler\nask something like that, kana? Kana?
//Fade to black\n//BG: Forest (night)
Hmm, that Rena girl\nis more cautious than she looks.
I brushed it off, but.\nShe's sharper than you'd expect\nfrom someone living an ordinary life in this boonies.
//Remu arrives.
Everyone's here?\nListen up, I'll tell you what I found out.
Did you gather info on the village?
There's a library in a place called Okinomiya,\nand I was able to research there.
What I learned is,\nin Hinamizawa village there was a past\nwhere residents rose up against the dam construction.
I saw that in the old magazine\nI read at the garbage dump.\nIs it true there was a murder at the construction site?
Yes, one of the culprits is still at large.\nAnd not only that - incidents related to the dam construction\nseem to still be going on.
Aria-chan, was "Onikakushi"\nmentioned in that magazine article?
Onikakushi? No, I didn't see it.
Onikakushi is an incident where, every year at a certain time,\none person dies in Hinamizawa village,\nand another person disappears.
Every year one person dies, and one disappears...?
Yes, it's continued for three years running.\nAnd that time has come again this year.
I have a really bad feeling about this.\nThat time is...
That time is, no way!?
Right. Tomorrow. The day of the Watanagashi festival.
Hold on!? So Doctor Death dragged us in\nat the worst possible timing?!
...Looks that way.\nIt'd be weirder to think\nthis isn't deliberate.
Even though victims turn up every year,\nRyugu Rena dodged it, saying "there's nothing"...
Then suspecting Rena-chan might be involved\nis detective theory 101.
No way!? That girl's the culprit!?
It's not zero possibility.\nDoctor Death might be involved too,\nso anything could happen.
I don't think Ryugu Rena is involved.
Why?
The reason... I don't know,\nbut I just feel it.
Can a Butei judge things on a feeling?\nDon't tell me it's because she said\n"So cuuute!" to you?
Don't be stupid.\nI'm bad at deduction, but I trust my gut!
Your gut, huh? What do you think, Remu?
I was thinking of skipping\nthe tour with Rena-chan and\nMion-chan tomorrow, but...
I'm going with Rena and them.\nI already promised.
It could be a trap, you know?
Then I just won't fall into the trap.
...Fine.
//Day two
Hello, Rena.
Huh? You're alone, kana? Kana?
Sorry, everyone couldn't wait\nand went on ahead.\nHopefully we can meet up with them later.
Hmm, I see.
Sorry to keep you waiting! Wait, just Aria?
They're all the type to do whatever they want.\nSorry for the bad manners.\nI'll apologize on their behalf.
I see. Even though I arranged for us\nto watch the dedication dance from the best spot.
Dedication dance?
The highlight of the Watanagashi festival\nis the dedication dance performed by\nthe Furude Shrine's shrine maiden.
Our friend Furude Rika-chan\nis the shrine maiden!\nHauu! Shrine-maiden Rika-chan is so cuuute!
You're not going to\ncharge at the dance, are you...
I'll stop her somehow if it comes to that.\nThe stalls are already open, so let's go!
//BG: Forest
Was it okay to let Aria go?
I let her go because she's Aria.\nShe's used to acting alone, and\nthere's information to gain from those girls.
This side's the harder one, actually.\nWe have to stay on guard in the middle of\na festival crowd, with few people.
//SE: higurashi cicadas crying
Whoa, people are gathering!\nLooks like it's almost festival time.
Oh, villagers are streaming along.\nIs it festival time soon?
Well, let's see if it's demons or snakes...
One person is killed, one disappears, huh.
I want to prevent any victims.\nAnd find Doctor Death, too.\nNow, begin the watch!
//Fade to black, insert night BG, then event CG\n//Event CG: Rika in shrine-maiden garb performing the Watanagashi ritual. The one where she pulls cotton with a hoe
So this is the dedication dance...
It's called "Watanagashi".
The Furude Shrine's shrine maiden tears open\nan old futon with a hoe, and everyone takes\na bit of the cotton out and floats it down the river.
A strange custom...
The cotton absorbs the bad things\nclinging to your body, so\nwe float it away.
That little girl with the hoe is the shrine maiden?
Yes, Furude Rika-chan!\nShe's this Furude Shrine's shrine maiden.\nShe's my cute little friend.
That hoe's supposed to be super heavy,\nso Rika-chan was\npracticing for the dance.
Aria-chan, when it's over let's go get cotton!
Can I, too?
Of course. Lots of people come from outside Hinamizawa\nto see this festival, so\nthey prepare tons of cotton.
When everyone floats it down the river together, it's so pretty.
I'm looking forward to that.
(Weird... Is this really the atmosphere of a festival\nwhere murders have happened three years running?\nI don't sense that at all...)
(Not just Rena and Mion -\nwhy can't I feel any fear or tension\nfrom the people around, either...?)
(The library records even document\nthe "Onikakushi" incidents... yet this air of\nnot caring at all is scary in reverse...)
(It's like everyone here\nis trying to trick and trap me.\nBut is that even possible?)
(Doctor Death... if it were him...?\nCould he pull off mass hypnosis?\nFor that, a backwater village like this...!?)
Hm? What's wrong, kana? Kana?
N-nothing.\nI was just thinking what a strange festival this is.
//Event CG off
Hmm, there's no sign of people at all.
Every last person has gathered at the festival,\nso there's nobody anywhere else.
And yet the incident will happen\neven though nobody's around?
If anything shows up, it'll be wild monkeys or bears, I guess?
If something happened to Aria,\nshe'd at least fire a shot.\nThe festival grounds show nothing abnormal, either.
Kyaa!
A voice!? Pinpoint the distance and direction!\nEveryone, let's go!
//Fade to black\n//BG: woods (night)
What is it!? Stay away!
What is that!?
It's a Nightmare!\nYou there! Leave this to us and run!
Y-yes!
There!
//SE: gunshot
Gweh!!
//Nightmare vanishes
We did it! Wait, just the one?
Looks like it.
The fact that there was a Nightmare means\nDoctor Death is definitely here.\nStay on guard!
//Fade to black\n//BG: Hinamizawa (night)
The Watanagashi river was beautiful.
Right? Now you too, Aria-chan,\nwill stay healthy for a year.
I'd appreciate that.\nI can't afford to get sick.
...I see. You're busy, huh.
Yes. Well, I'll head back now.\nThanks, Rena.
You're welcome.
...I wonder what she's busy with, kana? Kana?
//Fade to black\n//BG: Forest (night)\n//Aria walking
That's strange... this is toward the edge of the village.\nThere shouldn't have been any houses here, but...
Why is a Hinamizawa resident\nfollowing me, kana? Kana?
...How did you notice, kana? Kana?\nAn ordinary person wouldn't notice at that distance.
...What do you want?
Can I ask a question, kana? Kana?
What?
What are you all doing\nin Hinamizawa... kana.
I told you, we came traveling.
You won't tell me the truth?
I know. None of the nearby lodgings\nhave you staying there.\nAnd you haven't used any public transport, either.
W-we're camping! That's why there's no inn!\nAnd we came by car, so no buses or trains...
You're lying!!
What did you come here for, Aria-chan?\nWhere did you come from?\nWhy are you lying...? Kana?
Ugh... don't come... don't come near me!\nOne more step closer and...!!
What's wrong? Scratching your neck... is it itchy?\nOr is it a habit, kana? Kana?
//Battle map: Hinamizawa (night)
Rena! Don't come any closer to me!
Why not, kana? Kana?\nWe were watching the festival together just now.
Did I do something wrong, Rena?\nYou lied, Aria-chan, but\nI'll forgive you, okay?
But just one thing -\nI want you to answer my next question properly.
H-huh...?
What is... that, kana? Kana?
//Small fry appears behind Aria
Wh-!? What is this!?
Rena!! Did you call these things!?
Answer the question!!\nWhat is that! You know, don't you!!
(Rena called these!!\nSo she's the enemy... Was Remu's prediction right?\nThat hatchet... she's a murderer!!)
Kill or be killed!!
//Battle begins\n//Event triggers when Aria attacks Rena
That's cruel... I haven't\ndone anything to deserve this.
Shut up! Shut up shut up shut up!!
You!! You're just like...!!\nUwaaaaaah!!
//After several turns pass
Aria, what are you doing!?
You never came no matter how long we waited!
Don't come!! Nobody come near me!!
Aria?
Something's wrong with her...
Isn't something off?\nHer gaze isn't steady...?
Wait there!\nUgh, there's something in the way!!
//Battle resumes
How cruel...\nWhy would you do this...?
A-Aria... what have you done...
Aha... ahahaha! I did it!
I won't die! I refuse to die!
//Loop. Return to battle start
Ugh...!
Aria!? No way!?
No... no! I don't wanna die...!\nUwaaaaaaaaaah!
//Aria vanishes
Aria, where are you going!?
//Battle ends
Haa, haa...
Gehok, gehok...
My throat itches...\nIt won't stop... it won't stop...!
//Fade to black
Uwah...!\nGaaah, aah!
Gahaa... ah...
//SE: sound of scratching throat\n//Screen turns bright red
Every...one...
//Sound of collapsing
//Fade to black\n//BG: Forest (day)
Mornin', Aria.
//Event CG: Rin doing self-training in her IS suit. Stretching pose with her butt stuck out.
Yo... ho!
...What are you doing?
What else, training.
After chasing Doctor Death to this boonies,\nyou just kept sleeping, so\nI've been waiting for you to wake up.
...I was asleep?
While you were sleeping in,\nI leveled up by 1!\nI'm feeling great! Just kidding.
//Event CG off
Right, good for you.
You seem down? What's wrong?
I feel like I had a bad dream...
Hmm... well, snap out of it.\nIf you keep having weird dreams, Doctor Death'll come, y'know?
Though that'd save us the trouble of searching.\nAhaha!
...Right.
